name: Feather of Flight
description: Flash. Enchant creature. When this Aura enters the battlefield, draw a card. Enchanted creature gets +1/+0 and has flying.
assumptions: Read the two static effects (G's +1/+0, H's flying) as both applying to the enchanted creature, per the shared cond:equipped flag now present on the P/T node.
notes: First attempt correctly reconstructed everything except the connection between "enchanted creature" and the two static effects -- .EquippedBy was handled (tags cond:equipped) but the exact-parallel .EnchantedBy (Auras) was not, so node G had no signal tying its +1/+0 to the attached creature specifically. Fixed by extending the same equipped-flag check to also match .EnchantedBy, reusing the existing cond:equipped label since it's the identical mechanical fact (attached to the permanent granting this static) under Forge's two different attachment-type field names. Verified directly against the regenerated packet: node G now shows cond:equipped;delta=+1/+0. In blb-success.json.
